images.title: Two paint jugs in twelfths
images.purpose: Show the situation and the method cue: two 1 litre jugs marked in the same unit, twelfths, holding the yellow and blue paint to be mixed.
images.composition: Two straight-sided 1 litre jugs standing side by side on one baseline with wide space between them, and one question line centred below.
images.exact_structure: Left: one straight-sided 1 litre jug drawn as a plain upright rectangle with a small handle, marked inside by thin grey #6B7280 lines into 12 equal levels; the bottom 8 levels filled amber #E69F00 for yellow paint. Right: one jug of exactly the same size on the same baseline, also marked into 12 equal levels; the bottom 9 levels filled teal #0072B2 for blue paint. Both jugs topped by a thin reddish purple #CC79A7 line at the 1 litre mark. Centred below: one question line. Exactly 2 jugs, 12 levels each, 8 amber, 9 teal.
